scenario.name: Threshold hover with noise (A0)
scenario.hypothesis: Sensor noise right at the threshold may make the output chatter if there is no hysteresis.

evidence.before: D9 toggled 23 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 3.01 s (limit 2), and 30 times over the whole 8.00 s run.
evidence.after: D9 toggled 0 time(s) in 8.00 s, within the limit of 2 per 5000 ms.
